question: How much dataset signature is recoverable from each view?
method: Logistic regression on simple appearance descriptors (histogram, gradient statistics, frequency bands), evaluated with StratifiedGroupKFold so the probe cannot memorise individual patients.
conclusion: The dataset signature survives cropping - it is present in the lung parenchyma itself (reconstruction kernel, noise texture, compression). ROI cropping ALONE will not fix generalisation; intensity harmonisation and/or domain-adversarial training are required.
caveat: A high domain AUC does not by itself prove the clinical model uses the signature - only that it is available to be used. Combined with D26 (external AUC 0.488) the inference is well supported.
